start.content: We have just come down from the Mount of Olives. The crowd was massive! I have never heard so many people shouting the same thing at once. I was busy recording the names of the witnesses for my own account.

choices.text: Tell me about the crowd's testimony.
Did you see which way the donkey went?

testimony.content: They were shouting 'Hosanna!' from the tops of their lungs. I saw the Pharisees scribbling down complaints. I'm keeping a record of their written threats; it's significant evidence of their rejection.

tracks.content: The donkey tracks lead right down the western slope. We followed them all the way. A villager near the gate stopped us and asked why we were untying it, but he let us go once we spoke the words.

closing.content: Everything is happening as it was written. We are just witnesses.
